title: 2026-08-13 论文推荐
description: 9 篇推荐：LinearKV: One Cached State Suffices for Position-Independent Caching in Hybrid LLMs (机构未标注, 混合 LLM 做位置无关缓存只需一个缓存状态，无需精确组合多个状态。)、Massive Activations in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models: Pre-Attention Spikes and Inter-Spike Plateaus (机构未标注, 混合线性注意力 LLM 的巨量激活集中在全注意力层前，且可跨线性层形成平台。)、Total Recall at What Cost? Benchmarking the Serving Cost of Agentic Memory Systems (机构未标注, agentic 记忆系统的服务成本由内部记忆行为决定，且成本与准确率无法兼得。)、Information Abundance Paradox: Long-Context Training Undermines Parametric Knowledge (Johns Hopkins University, 训练上下文越丰富，模型越依赖上下文而越少内化参数知识。)、One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL (Stanford University, UC Berkeley, 单 LLM 模拟器训练会让策略过拟合模拟器主导模式，群体协同训练是解药。)、Ripple-Pivot Search: Active Parallel Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models (机构未标注, 先提交一个中等熵枢轴 token 可引发涟漪效应，让扩散模型并行解码快 4-10 倍。)、Hybrid Gated Attention (机构未标注, 用多阶段信息构造混合门控，注意力表征更强且训练更稳。)、Rethinking Agent Security as a Networking Problem (University of Chicago, agent 安全应像网络一样由外部基础设施执行策略，而非依赖 agent 自律。)、Disentangling the Expressivity of RoPE (ETH Zürich, 常规 RoPE 旋转永不重复，表达力只是有界局部回看而非全长度模算术。)

highlights.note: 长上下文训练削弱参数知识内化
